name: Volcán Tajumulco
subtitle: Sierra Madre de Chiapas
description: Highest mountain in Guatemala and in all of Central America
extract: Volcán Tajumulco is a large stratovolcano in the department of San Marcos in western Guatemala. It is the highest mountain in Central America at 4,203 metres (13,789 ft). It is part of the mountain range of the Sierra Madre de Chiapas, which begins in Mexico's southernmost state of Chiapas.
